data.long_meaning: The name Sidd is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sidh’ which means ‘achieved’, ‘accomplished’, ‘perfected’. This name is often given to a child who is expected to achieve great things in life, and is believed to bring prosperity, success, and wisdom. It is also a name of several Hindu deities, including Lord Siddeshvara and Lord Siddhi Vinayak.
